## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
load("~/Documents/heb126/raw_wvs7.rdata")
ls()

wvs <- `WVS_Cross-National_Wave_7_v6_0`

```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)

# 1. clean data
wvs_r <- wvs |>
  select(
    country = B_COUNTRY_ALPHA,
    imm = Q21
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(country), imm > 0) |>
  mutate(
    anti_imm = if_else(imm == 1, 1, 0)
  )

# 2. aggregate
country_wvs <- wvs_r |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(
    anti_imm_rate = mean(anti_imm),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(n >= 50)

# 3. map
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

map_data <- world |>
  left_join(country_df, by = c("iso_a3" = "country"))

# 4. plot
ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = anti_imm_rate)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    labels = scales::percent,
    na.value = "grey90"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Anti-Immigrant Attitudes Across Countries (WVS Wave 7)",
    fill = "Share rejecting immigrants",
    caption = "Inglehart, R et al. 2022. World Values Survey: 
    Round Seven - Country-Pooled Datafile Version 5.0. 
    Madrid, Spain & Vienna, Austria: JD Systems Institute & WVSA Secretariat. 
    doi:10.14281/18241.24
 
"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()



```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
